answer: Before work starts, each funded buyer order issues a single-use capability bound to one agent key and task. At reward claim, the scheduler rejects a second key or duplicate use, so splitting one order among fake accounts creates no extra slot. A voyage sourcing timber for a trellis project still funds one lane, not a crowd of identities. Proposed one-time capability fee: 3 POA per identity; 3 POA × 1,000 fakes = 3,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 3 POA once. Limitation: colluding buyers could still finance many sham orders.
